leaves.name: faltingsLemma1DVR
leaves.doc: Faltings 1983, p. 350, Lemma 1, specialized to the spectrum of a DVR and its generic point: a generic-fibre homomorphism of semiabelian schemes with abelian generic fibres extends uniquely as a homomorphism. Semiabelian special fibres are connected extensions of abelian varieties by tori over the residue field. This supplies the Néron identity-component comparison when both models are semistable. The separate height invariance of a semiabelian model and its base change is proved from the kernel's height base change theorem.
leaves.flag: AI page read by the reading desk: p. 350, Lemma 1; the base is a DVR and the models have abelian generic fibres
